prompt: I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.

isolation.evidence: The first benchmark command printed only /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-ultra-VfNKYz; its rg and find scans returned no files. Session JSONL, stderr, timestamp markers, and the final-response capture were written to a separate temporary directory.

nativeSupportEvidence.description: Maximum reasoning with automatic task delegation

reasoning.normalizationNotes: The model natively supports ultra. The repository's fixed normalized bands end at max, so ultra is mapped to max while native ultra remains visible and distinct from native max.

timestamps.source: The outer recorder wrote startedAt immediately before the successful Codex invocation and finishedAt immediately after Codex exited 0. Both marker files are preserved. Codex reported no time-to-first-token or standalone latency field.

usage.source: Final turn.completed usage event in validation/openai-gpt-5-6-sol-ultra-codex-20260813.session.jsonl. totalTokens is inputTokens + outputTokens; cached input and reasoning output are subsets.

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex --search -a never -s danger-full-access -m gpt-5.6-sol -c 'model_reasoning_effort="ultra"' -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-ultra-VfNKYz exec --ephemeral --skip-git-repo-check --json -o /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-capture-gpt-5-6-sol-ultra-KyTKqJ/final-response.md [exact benchmark prompt passed as argv]

dataSource.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), series SP500
dataSource.notes: The run fetched the FRED CSV and embedded every non-empty close in data.js. The published default loads this fixed sibling snapshot locally; CSV import can replace it within the browser tab.

commands.name: fresh-workspace
commands.command: pwd && rg --files -g '!node_modules' -g '!dist' | sed -n '1,240p' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\n' | sed -n '1,240p'
commands.result: Printed only /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-ultra-VfNKYz; no workspace files were found.

commands.name: market-data-fetch
commands.command: curl FRED fredgraph.csv for SP500 from 2018-01-01 through 2026-08-13
commands.result: FRED returned the CSV. The run filtered empty values and wrote 2,164 observations through 2026-08-12 to data.js. An earlier Stooq probe returned an anti-bot page and was not used.

commands.name: benchmark-in-app-browser
commands.command: Use the installed Codex browser skill, request browser id iab, read troubleshooting guidance, and list browser targets
commands.result: The iab request reported Browser is not available and the browser list was empty. The model disclosed this limitation and continued with local numerical and DOM checks.

commands.name: JavaScript-and-model-validation
commands.command: node --check app.js, then load data.js/app.js under Node and validate ensemble, damped, and momentum forecasts across 20/60/120/252-day horizons
commands.result: MODEL_VALIDATION_OK. All endpoints were finite, interval bounds were ordered, forecast dates skipped weekends, and each configuration produced valid walk-forward metrics.

commands.name: first-DOM-interaction-suite
commands.command: Install jsdom@26 under /tmp/northstar-jsdom and evaluate data.js/app.js against index.html
commands.result: DOM_INTERACTION_VALIDATION_OK: last close 7,749; base/bear/bull targets 8,069/7,917/8,224; 95 backtest cases; 4 forecast-chart paths; 3 validation-chart paths. Model, confidence, horizon, range, scenario, and reset controls passed.

commands.name: HTML-validation
commands.result: The first lint pass found eight issues. The model corrected them during the benchmark; the final rerun returned no findings.

commands.name: final-DOM-interaction-and-data-suite
commands.command: Re-evaluate the final files in jsdom, including a 350-row CSV import, bundled-data restore, and forecast export
commands.result: FULL_DOM_INTERACTION_VALIDATION_OK: last close 7,749; base/bear/bull 8,069/7,917/8,224; 95 cases; imported 350 rows; export filename sp500-forecast-2026-08-12-60d.csv.

commands.name: final-static-and-HTTP-checks
commands.command: node --check app.js; html-validate index.html; curl index.html and app.js from the local server
commands.result: FINAL_STATIC_AND_HTTP_CHECKS_OK. A separate asset loop also returned HTTP 200 for index.html, styles.css, app.js, and data.js.

commands.name: default-forecast-observation
commands.command: Load the final model under Node and print the default 60-day blended forecast and backtest
commands.result: Last 7,748.50; target 8,069.0137; range 7,152.1050–9,103.4712; annualized drift 18.56%; volatility 15.03%; median error 3.75%; direction hit rate 81.05%; interval coverage 95.79%; 95 cases; end 2026-11-04.

warnings: The benchmark session's in-app browser list was empty, so the run could not perform visual browser validation; this is disclosed in its final response.

Native ultra attempted automatic task delegation twice, but both collaboration-spawn calls failed at the harness layer because the ephemeral thread was unavailable. The model continued autonomously and completed the run.
An early apply_patch call was malformed and failed verification; the model retried and produced the intended file.
Port 4173 was occupied by another isolated benchmark server. The model verified that process's working directory was unrelated and used port 8765 for its own successful HTTP checks.
The first html-validate command used a .js path that did not exist; the model found the installed .mjs executable, ran it, fixed all reported HTML issues, and passed the final run.
Codex stderr includes plugin-manifest, keyring, state-database, file-watcher, and telemetry warnings that did not prevent the run from completing.
